<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0807">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #0a0807;
    overflow: hidden;
    overscroll-behavior: none;
  }
  #scene {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" role="img" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen in warm lamplight"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
'use strict';

const TAU = Math.PI * 2, PI = Math.PI;
const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

const clamp = (v, a, b) => v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v;
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const rgb = (r, g, b, a) => a === undefined
  ? `rgb(${r | 0},${g | 0},${b | 0})`
  : `rgba(${r | 0},${g | 0},${b | 0},${a})`;

function mulberry32(seed) {
  return function () {
    seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ seed >>> 15, 1 | seed);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
const rnd = mulberry32(20240902);

const mq = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
let reduced = mq.matches;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout
let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
const L = {};            // scene geometry (CSS px)
let bowlCache = null;    // offscreen: shadow, foot, ceramic body
let steamSprite = null;
let grainPath = null;
let vignetteGrad = null, bgGrad = null, glowGrad = null, poolGrad = null, hazeGrad = null;

function layout() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = H + 'px';

  const R = clamp(Math.min(W * 0.36, H * 0.29), 70, 620);
  L.R = R;
  L.ry = R * 0.40;
  L.cx = W / 2;
  L.cy = H * 0.55 + L.ry * 0.15;
  L.rimT = R * 0.055;
  L.bx = L.cx;
  L.by = L.cy + L.ry * 0.24;
  L.brx = R * 0.875;
  L.bry = L.ry * 0.875;
  L.bodyH = R * 0.74;

  buildBowlCache();
  buildGradients();
  buildGrain();
  if (!steamSprite) steamSprite = makeSteamSprite();
}

function buildGradients() {
  const { R, cx, cy, ry } = L;

  bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#060504');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#100b09');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0b0807');

  glowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 2.4);
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,165,85,0.22)');
  glowGrad.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(220,110,50,0.10)');
  glowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

  poolGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 1.9);
  poolGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,70,0.16)');
  poolGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(180,80,30,0.06)');
  poolGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

  hazeGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, R * 1.15);
  hazeGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,235,215,0.55)');
  hazeGrad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,235,215,0.18)');
  hazeGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,235,215,0)');

  const rIn = Math.min(W, H) * 0.32, rOut = Math.hypot(W, H) * 0.62;
  vignetteGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy - ry, rIn, cx, cy - ry, rOut);
  vignetteGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  vignetteGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.88)');
}

function buildGrain() {
  // faint wood grain on the table surface
  const p = new Path2D();
  const g = mulberry32(77);
  const y0 = L.cy + L.ry * 0.8;
  const n = 26;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const y = y0 + (H - y0) * (i + g()) / n;
    const amp = 2 + g() * 6, f = 0.004 + g() * 0.006, ph = g() * TAU;
    p.moveTo(-10, y);
    for (let x = 0; x <= W + 20; x += 24) {
      p.lineTo(x, y + Math.sin(x * f + ph) * amp + Math.sin(x * f * 3.1 + ph * 2) * amp * 0.3);
    }
  }
  grainPath = p;
}

function buildBowlCache() {
  const { R, ry, bodyH } = L;
  const pad = R * 0.35;
  const w = R * 2.6 + pad * 2, h = ry + bodyH + ry * 0.6 + pad * 2;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = Math.ceil(w * DPR);
  cv.height = Math.ceil(h * DPR);
  const c = cv.getContext('2d');
  c.scale(DPR, DPR);
  const cx = w / 2, cy = pad + ry;
  bowlCache = { cv, w, h, ox: cx, oy: cy };

  // contact shadow on the table
  c.save();
  c.translate(cx + R * 0.14, cy + bodyH * 0.98);
  c.scale(1, 0.42);
  let g = c.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.25, 0, 0, R * 1.25);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.78)');
  g.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.42)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(-R * 1.4, -R * 1.4, R * 2.8, R * 2.8);
  c.restore();

  // foot ring
  c.save();
  c.beginPath();
  c.ellipse(cx, cy + bodyH, R * 0.5, ry * 0.5, 0, 0, TAU);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(cx - R * 0.5, 0, cx + R * 0.5, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d10');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#1c1b20');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0b0b0e');
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fill();
  c.restore();

  // body
  const body = new Path2D();
  body.moveTo(cx - R, cy);
  body.bezierCurveTo(cx - R * 1.0, cy + ry * 2.3, cx - R * 0.78, cy + bodyH, cx - R * 0.5, cy + bodyH);
  body.lineTo(cx + R * 0.5, cy + bodyH);
  body.bezierCurveTo(cx + R * 0.78, cy + bodyH, cx + R * 1.0, cy + ry * 2.3, cx + R, cy);
  body.ellipse(cx, cy, R, ry, 0, 0, PI);
  body.closePath();

  c.save();
  c.clip(body);
  g = c.createLinearGradient(cx - R, 0, cx + R, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#111114');
  g.addColorStop(0.17, '#2a292f');
  g.addColorStop(0.31, '#3d3c43');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#2a2930');
  g.addColorStop(0.82, '#151518');
  g.addColorStop(0.95, '#232226');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#3a342f');
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // vertical darkening toward the foot
  g = c.createLinearGradient(0, cy, 0, cy + bodyH);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  g.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.62)');
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // warm bounce from the table / broth glow along the lower right
  g = c.createRadialGradient(cx + R * 0.7, cy + bodyH * 0.7, 0, cx + R * 0.7, cy + bodyH * 0.7, R * 0.9);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,120,50,0.10)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,50,0)');
  c.fillStyle = g;
  c.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // glaze speckle
  const sp = mulberry32(99);
  for (let i = 0; i < 520; i++) {
    const x = cx + (sp() * 2 - 1) * R;
    const y = cy + sp() * bodyH;
    const r = 0.4 + sp() * 1.1;
    c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,245,230,${0.03 + sp() * 0.09})`;
    c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, r, 0, TAU); c.fill();
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
    const x = cx + (sp() * 2 - 1) * R;
    const y = cy + sp() * bodyH;
    c.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${0.08 + sp() * 0.18})`;
    c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, 0.5 + sp() * 1.4, 0, TAU); c.fill();
  }
  c.restore();

  // soft edge highlight on the left (key light) and rim light on the right
  c.save();
  c.clip(body);
  c.lineCap = 'round';
  c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,225,0.10)';
  c.lineWidth = R * 0.05;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(cx - R * 0.93, cy + ry * 0.5);
  c.bezierCurveTo(cx - R * 0.93, cy + ry * 2.1, cx - R * 0.74, cy + bodyH * 0.88, cx - R * 0.55, cy + bodyH * 0.92);
  c.stroke();
  c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,110,0.16)';
  c.lineWidth = R * 0.025;
  c.beginPath();
  c.moveTo(cx + R * 0.98, cy + ry * 0.3);
  c.bezierCurveTo(cx + R * 0.98, cy + ry * 2.1, cx + R * 0.78, cy + bodyH * 0.9, cx + R * 0.5, cy + bodyH * 0.97);
  c.stroke();
  c.restore();
}

function makeSteamSprite() {
  const s = 160;
  const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = cv.height = s;
  const c = cv.getContext('2d');
  const blobs = [[80, 84, 66], [52, 92, 40], [106, 62, 38], [70, 50, 30], [100, 104, 34]];
  for (const [x, y, r] of blobs) {
    const g = c.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,242,228,0.55)');
    g.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,242,228,0.20)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,242,228,0)');
    c.fillStyle = g;
    c.fillRect(0, 0, s, s);
  }
  return cv;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- content
// Everything inside the bowl lives in unit coordinates of the broth ellipse:
// u, v in [-1, 1], u*u + v*v <= 1. v < 0 is the far side of the bowl.
const noodles = [];
const topStrands = [];
const items = [];     // larger toppings, drawn back to front
const floaters = [];  // small bits floating on the broth surface
const oils = [];
const swirls = [];

function genContent() {
  const NC = [-0.16, 0.06];
  for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
    const pts = [];
    const a0 = rnd() * TAU;
    const dir = rnd() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
    const r0 = 0.10 + rnd() * 0.44;
    const n = 6 + (rnd() * 5 | 0);
    const step = (0.38 + rnd() * 0.5) * dir;
    const ph = rnd() * TAU;
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      const a = a0 + step * k;
      const r = r0 + Math.sin(k * 1.15 + ph) * 0.10 + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.035;
      pts.push([NC[0] + Math.cos(a) * r, NC[1] + Math.sin(a) * r]);
    }
    const strand = { pts, ph: rnd() * TAU, w: 0.85 + rnd() * 0.3 };
    noodles.push(strand);
    if (i >= 16) topStrands.push(strand);
  }

  const add = (type, u, v, s, extra) => items.push(Object.assign({ type, u, v, s, rot: rnd() * TAU, ph: rnd() * TAU }, extra || {}));

  add('nori', -0.5, -0.66, 1);
  add('bokchoy', 0.50, -0.56, 1, { dir: 1 });
  add('bokchoy', 0.66, -0.36, 0.9, { dir: 1 });
  add('shiitake', -0.56, -0.36, 1);
  add('shiitake', -0.30, -0.50, 0.92);
  add('shiitake', 0.02, -0.56, 0.86);
  add('tofu', 0.44, 0.14, 1);
  add('tofu', 0.68, 0.02, 0.95);
  add('tofu', 0.56, 0.42, 1.02);
  add('tofu', 0.30, 0.48, 0.9);
  add('carrot', 0.10, -0.18, 1);
  add('carrot', -0.36, 0.30, 0.92);

  const addF = (type, u, v, s, extra) => floaters.push(Object.assign({ type, u, v, s, rot: rnd() * TAU, ph: rnd() * TAU }, extra || {}));
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.17;
    addF('corn', -0.50 + Math.cos(a) * r, 0.50 + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.8, 0.85 + rnd() * 0.3);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = 0.15 + Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.72;
    addF('scallion', Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.75 + rnd() * 0.5);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.9;
    addF('sesame', Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.8 + rnd() * 0.5);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.85;
    addF('flake', Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.7 + rnd() * 0.6);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    oils.push({ a: rnd() * TAU, r: 0.15 + Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.78, w: (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.05, rr: 0.012 + rnd() * 0.02, ph: rnd() * TAU });
  }
  swirls.push({ u: 0.12, v: 0.10, r: 0.42, a: 0.6, sw: 2.4, spin: 0.028 });
  swirls.push({ u: -0.08, v: 0.02, r: 0.62, a: 3.4, sw: 1.7, spin: -0.02 });
  swirls.push({ u: 0.22, v: 0.24, r: 0.24, a: 1.9, sw: 3.1, spin: 0.04 });

  items.sort((a, b) => a.v - b.v);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- pointer
const m = {
  x: -1e5, y: -1e5, has: false, hover: false,
  tx: 0, ty: 0, ex: 0, ey: 0,
  vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0, hoverAmt: 0,
};
let lastPT = 0;
const lastRip = { x: 0, y: 0, t: 0 };

function updatePointer(x, y, now) {
  if (m.has) {
    const dtm = Math.max(8, now - lastPT) / 1000;
    m.vx = lerp(m.vx, (x - m.x) / dtm, 0.45);
    m.vy = lerp(m.vy, (y - m.y) / dtm, 0.45);
  }
  m.x = x; m.y = y; m.has = true; lastPT = now;
  m.tx = clamp((x - W / 2) / (W / 2), -1, 1);
  m.ty = clamp((y - H / 2) / (H / 2), -1, 1);
  const u = (x - L.bx) / L.brx, v = (y - L.by) / L.bry;
  m.hover = u * u + v * v < 1;
  if (m.hover) {
    const dx = x - lastRip.x, dy = y - lastRip.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > (L.R * 0.05) ** 2 && now - lastRip.t > 55) {
      const strength = clamp(Math.hypot(m.vx, m.vy) / (L.R * 4), 0.15, 1);
      addRipple(u, v, 0.10 + strength * 0.28, 0.9 + strength * 0.9, 0.35 + strength * 0.35);
      lastRip.x = x; lastRip.y = y; lastRip.t = now;
    }
  }
}

function onMove(e) {
  if (reduced) return;
  updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY, performance.now());
}

function onDown(e) {
  if (reduced) return;
  const now = performance.now();
  updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY, now);
  if (m.hover) {
    const u = (e.clientX - L.bx) / L.brx, v = (e.clientY - L.by) / L.bry;
    addRipple(u, v, 0.55, 2.2, 0.7);
    addRipple(u, v, 0.32, 1.4, 0.5);
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) spawnSteam(u + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, v + (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.2, 1.8);
  }
}

function onLeave() {
  m.has = false; m.hover = false;
  m.tx = 0; m.ty = 0;
  m.x = -1e5; m.y = -1e5;
  m.vx = 0; m.vy = 0;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dynamics
const steam = [];
const ripples = [];
let steamAcc = 0;
let nextBubble = 1.5;

function spawnSteam(u, v, boost) {
  if (steam.length > 220) return;
  const R = L.R;
  steam.push({
    x: L.bx + u * L.brx, y: L.by + v * L.bry,
    vx: 0, vy: 0,
    rise: R * (0.10 + rnd() * 0.10) * (boost || 1),
    life: 0, max: 3.2 + rnd() * 3.2,
    s0: R * (0.14 + rnd() * 0.10), grow: R * (0.42 + rnd() * 0.3),
    seed: rnd() * TAU, rot: rnd() * TAU, spin: (rnd() - 0.5) * 0.5,
    a: 0.10 + rnd() * 0.07,
  });
}

function emitSteam(rate, dt) {
  steamAcc += rate * dt;
  while (steamAcc >= 1) {
    steamAcc -= 1;
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.72;
    spawnSteam(-0.1 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
  }
}

function addRipple(u, v, max, dur, amp) {
  if (ripples.length > 40) ripples.shift();
  ripples.push({ u, v, max, dur, amp, life: 0 });
}

function step(t, dt) {
  // pointer easing
  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3.2);
  m.ex += (m.tx - m.ex) * k;
  m.ey += (m.ty - m.ey) * k;
  const decay = Math.exp(-dt * 5);
  m.vx *= decay; m.vy *= decay;
  m.speed = Math.hypot(m.vx, m.vy);
  m.hoverAmt += ((m.hover ? 1 : 0) - m.hoverAmt) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 2.5));

  // steam
  const R = L.R;
  emitSteam(16 + m.hoverAmt * 12, dt);
  const wind = m.ex * R * 0.10;
  const pushR = R * 0.75;
  for (let i = steam.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = steam[i];
    p.life += dt;
    if (p.life > p.max || p.y < -R) { steam[i] = steam[steam.length - 1]; steam.pop(); continue; }
    const kk = p.life / p.max;
    const wob = Math.sin(t * 1.25 + p.seed) * R * 0.07 + Math.sin(t * 0.41 + p.seed * 2.3) * R * 0.05;
    const tvx = wind * (0.4 + kk) + wob;
    const tvy = -p.rise * (1 + kk * 0.9);
    p.vx += (tvx - p.vx) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 1.1));
    p.vy += (tvy - p.vy) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 0.9));
    if (m.has) {
      const dx = p.x - m.x, dy = p.y - m.y;
      const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (d2 < pushR * pushR) {
        const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 1;
        const f = (1 - d / pushR);
        const gust = f * f * dt;
        p.vx += (dx / d) * gust * (m.speed * 0.55 + R * 0.35) + m.vx * f * 0.5 * dt;
        p.vy += (dy / d) * gust * (m.speed * 0.35 + R * 0.15) + m.vy * f * 0.5 * dt;
        p.life += gust * 1.8;  // disturbed steam disperses sooner
      }
    }
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.rot += p.spin * dt;
  }

  // ripples
  for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const r = ripples[i];
    r.life += dt;
    if (r.life > r.dur) { ripples.splice(i, 1); }
  }

  // an occasional bubble rising to the surface on its own
  nextBubble -= dt;
  if (nextBubble <= 0) {
    nextBubble = 1.4 + rnd() * 2.8;
    const a = rnd() * TAU, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.8;
    addRipple(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.05 + rnd() * 0.07, 1.2 + rnd() * 0.8, 0.35);
    spawnSteam(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 1.3);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
function toX(u, px) { return L.bx + u * L.brx + px; }
function toY(v, py) { return L.by + v * L.bry + py; }

function roundRect(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
  if (c.roundRect) { c.roundRect(x, y, w, h, r); return; }
  c.moveTo(x + r, y);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  c.closePath();
}

function flicker(t) {
  return 1 + 0.030 * Math.sin(t * 7.3) * Math.sin(t * 3.1) + 0.018 * Math.sin(t * 13.7 + 1) + 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 0.9);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
function drawBackground(t, fl) {
  const { R, cx, cy, bodyH } = L;
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // pool of lamplight on the table
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx + R * 0.05 - m.ex * R * 0.06, cy + bodyH * 0.95);
  ctx.scale(1, 0.36);
  ctx.globalAlpha = fl;
  ctx.fillStyle = poolGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(-R * 2, -R * 2, R * 4, R * 4);
  ctx.restore();

  // wood grain
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,205,160,0.035)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke(grainPath);
  ctx.restore();

  // ambient warm glow around the bowl
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx - m.ex * R * 0.14, cy - R * 0.55 - m.ey * R * 0.08);
  ctx.scale(1, 0.85);
  ctx.globalAlpha = fl * (0.9 + m.hoverAmt * 0.25);
  ctx.fillStyle = glowGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(-R * 2.6, -R * 2.6, R * 5.2, R * 5.2);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawInnerWall(px, py) {
  const { R, ry, brx, bry } = L;
  const cx = L.cx + px, cy = L.cy + py;
  const by = L.by + py;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R, ry, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.clip();
  ctx.translate(cx, by);
  ctx.scale(1, ry / R);
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, brx * 0.9, 0, 0, R * 1.05);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#5a2c12');
  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#34190d');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#17100b');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-R * 1.2, -R * 1.6, R * 2.4, R * 3.2);
  // lamp catching the far inner wall
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy - ry, 0, by - bry);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,190,120,0.30)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,190,120,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(cx - R, cy - ry, R * 2, ry * 2);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRim(px, py, half) {
  const { R, ry, rimT } = L;
  const cx = L.cx + px, cy = L.cy + py;
  const a0 = half === 'far' ? PI : 0, a1 = half === 'far' ? TAU : PI;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
  // base ring
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT / 2, ry - rimT / 2, 0, a0 - 0.02, a1 + 0.02);
  ctx.lineWidth = rimT;
  ctx.strokeStyle = half === 'far' ? '#3a393f' : '#2b2a30';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  if (half === 'far') {
    // key light highlight along the far-left rim
    const c = PI * 1.42 + m.ex * 0.16;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT / 2, ry - rimT / 2, 0, c - 0.75, c + 0.55);
    ctx.lineWidth = rimT * 0.55;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,200,215,0.55)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT / 2, ry - rimT / 2, 0, c - 0.35, c + 0.2);
    ctx.lineWidth = rimT * 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,250,240,0.55)';
    ctx.stroke();
    // broth glow on the far inner lip
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT * 0.95, ry - rimT * 0.95, 0, PI * 1.1, PI * 1.9);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,150,80,0.30)';
    ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    // glazed lip catching the broth on the near side
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT * 0.95, ry - rimT * 0.95, 0, PI * 0.1, PI * 0.9);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,160,90,0.45)';
    ctx.stroke();
    // top-of-rim sheen from the lamp
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R - rimT / 2, ry - rimT / 2, 0, PI * 0.42 - m.ex * 0.2, PI * 0.78 - m.ex * 0.2);
    ctx.lineWidth = rimT * 0.35;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,180,195,0.22)';
    ctx.stroke();
    // outer edge
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, R, ry, 0, 0, PI);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function traceStrand(pts, px, py, bob) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  let x0 = toX(pts[0][0], px), y0 = toY(pts[0][1], py) + bob;
  ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const xa = toX(pts[i][0], px), ya = toY(pts[i][1], py) + bob;
    const xb = toX(pts[i + 1][0], px), yb = toY(pts[i + 1][1], py) + bob;
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(xa, ya, (xa + xb) / 2, (ya + yb) / 2);
  }
  const l = pts[pts.length - 1];
  ctx.lineTo(toX(l[0], px), toY(l[1], py) + bob);
}

function drawNoodles(list, t, px, py, alpha) {
  const R = L.R;
  const wBase = R * 0.028;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  for (const s of list) {
    const bob = Math.sin(t * 0.9 + s.ph) * R * 0.004;
    const w = wBase * s.w;
    traceStrand(s.pts, px, py + 1.5, bob);
    ctx.lineWidth = w + 2.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(70,30,5,0.55)';
    ctx.stroke();
    traceStrand(s.pts, px, py, bob);
    ctx.lineWidth = w;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e9c878';
    ctx.stroke();
    traceStrand(s.pts, px - w * 0.18, py - w * 0.22, bob);
    ctx.lineWidth = w * 0.32;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,243,205,0.75)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBroth(t, px, py, fl) {
  const { R, brx, bry } = L;
  const bx = L.bx + px, by = L.by + py;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brx, bry, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.clip();

  // liquid base
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(bx, by);
  ctx.scale(1, bry / brx);
  let g = ctx.createRadialGradient(-brx * 0.22, -brx * 0.12, brx * 0.05, 0, 0, brx);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#e69a3c');
  g.addColorStop(0.42, '#c46c1e');
  g.addColorStop(0.8, '#8f4212');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#5e2a0c');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-brx, -brx, brx * 2, brx * 2);
  ctx.restore();

  // submerged noodles
  drawNoodles(noodles, t, px, py, 1);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(205,105,30,0.34)';
  ctx.fillRect(bx - brx, by - bry, brx * 2, bry * 2);

  // wall shadow across the far side of the broth
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, by - bry, 0, by - bry * 0.15);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(45,12,0,0.55)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(45,12,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(bx - brx, by - bry, brx * 2, bry * 2);

  // chili oil swirls, slowly turning
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (const s of swirls) {
    const a = s.a + t * s.spin;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(toX(s.u, px), toY(s.v, py), s.r * brx, s.r * bry, 0, a, a + s.sw);
    ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.055;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,45,10,0.18)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = R * 0.02;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(215,55,15,0.5)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // strands breaking the surface
  drawNoodles(topStrands, t, px, py, 1);

  // oil droplets drifting on the surface
  for (const o of oils) {
    const a = o.a + t * o.w + Math.sin(t * 0.3 + o.ph) * 0.05;
    const r = o.r + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + o.ph) * 0.02;
    const x = toX(Math.cos(a) * r, px), y = toY(Math.sin(a) * r, py);
    const rr = o.rr * R;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, rr, rr * 0.8, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,205,105,0.30)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,238,190,0.45)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x - rr * 0.35, y - rr * 0.35, rr * 0.22, 0, TAU);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,240,0.55)';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // specular shimmer that follows the light
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  const sx = bx + brx * (-0.26 + m.ex * 0.22) + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * brx * 0.025;
  const sy = by + bry * (-0.30 + m.ey * 0.22) + Math.cos(t * 0.5) * bry * 0.04;
  const breathe = 1 + 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 1.3);
  ctx.translate(sx, sy);
  ctx.scale(1, bry / brx);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, brx * 0.6 * breathe);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,225,170,0.42)');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,200,140,0.12)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,200,140,0)');
  ctx.globalAlpha = fl;
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-brx, -brx, brx * 2, brx * 2);
  g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, brx * 0.16 * breathe);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,245,215,0.55)');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,245,215,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(-brx, -brx, brx * 2, brx * 2);
  ctx.restore();

  // moving light lines on the surface
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,240,205,0.13)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const y0 = by + bry * (-0.45 + i * 0.28);
    const k = 0.9 / R, sp = 0.6 + i * 0.13, amp = bry * 0.05;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = bx - brx; x <= bx + brx; x += 6) {
      const y = y0 + Math.sin(x * k * 8 + t * sp + i) * amp + Math.sin(x * k * 19 - t * sp * 1.7) * amp * 0.4;
      x === bx - brx ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  // ripples
  for (const r of ripples) {
    const k = r.life / r.dur;
    const e = 1 - (1 - k) * (1 - k);
    const rad = e * r.max;
    const a = (1 - k) * r.amp;
    const x = toX(r.u, px), y = toY(r.v, py);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + (1 - k) * 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad * brx, rad * bry, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,225,170,${a})`;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, rad * brx * 0.82, rad * bry * 0.82, 0, 0, TAU);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(80,25,0,${a * 0.55})`;
    ctx.stroke();
    if (k < 0.25) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, (1 - k * 4) * R * 0.012, 0, TAU);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,210,${(1 - k * 4) * 0.7})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // small things floating on top
  drawFloaters(t, px, py);

  ctx.restore();

  // meniscus edge
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brx, bry, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(55,18,4,0.6)';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brx * 0.985, bry * 0.985, 0, PI * 0.12, PI * 0.88);
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,140,0.28)';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFloaters(t, px, py) {
  const R = L.R;
  for (const f of floaters) {
    const bob = Math.sin(t * 1.1 + f.ph) * R * 0.005;
    const x = toX(f.u, px), y = toY(f.v, py) + bob;
    const rot = f.rot + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + f.ph) * 0.05;
    switch (f.type) {
      case 'scallion': drawScallion(x, y, R * 0.03 * f.s, rot); break;
      case 'sesame': drawSesame(x, y, R * 0.013 * f.s, rot); break;
      case 'flake': drawFlake(x, y, R * 0.014 * f.s, rot); break;
      case 'corn': drawCorn(x, y, R * 0.036 * f.s, rot); break;
    }
  }
}

function drawScallion(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(1, 1.5, s, s * 0.8, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,15,0,0.35)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s, s * 0.8, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6aa94a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a7530';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s * 0.72, s * 0.56, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,210,120,0.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s * 0.45, s * 0.34, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#d9ecb0';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s * 0.2, s * 0.15, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8cc46a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSesame(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(0, 0, s, s * 0.55, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f6eedb';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,80,30,0.5)';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFlake(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-s, -s * 0.5);
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.9, -s * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.3, s * 0.8);
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.6, s * 0.5);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c4301a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(-s * 0.1, s * 0.05, s * 0.28, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0c47a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCorn(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.beginPath();
  roundRect(ctx, -s * 0.5 + 1, -s * 0.42 + 1.5, s, s * 0.84, s * 0.28);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,15,0,0.35)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  roundRect(ctx, -s * 0.5, -s * 0.42, s, s * 0.84, s * 0.28);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f6c645';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c98f18';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.15, -s * 0.15, s * 0.2, s * 0.12, -0.6, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,250,220,0.75)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawToppings(t, px, py) {
  const R = L.R;
  for (const it of items) {
    const bob = Math.sin(t * 1.15 + it.ph) * R * 0.006;
    const rot = it.rot + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + it.ph) * 0.03;
    const x = toX(it.u, px), y = toY(it.v, py) + bob;
    switch (it.type) {
      case 'tofu': drawTofu(x, y, R * 0.115 * it.s, rot); break;
      case 'shiitake': drawShiitake(x, y, R * 0.13 * it.s, rot); break;
      case 'bokchoy': drawBokChoy(x, y - bob * 0.5, R * 0.22 * it.s, it.dir, t + it.ph); break;
      case 'nori': drawNori(x, y - bob, R, t); break;
      case 'carrot': drawCarrot(x, y, R * 0.052 * it.s, rot); break;
    }
  }
}

function drawTofu(x, y, s, rot) {
  const asp = L.bry / L.brx;
  const h = s * 0.42;
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const a = rot + i * PI / 2 + PI / 4;
    pts.push([x + Math.cos(a) * s * 0.7071, y + Math.sin(a) * s * 0.7071 * asp]);
  }
  // shadow
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const p = pts[i];
    i ? ctx.lineTo(p[0] + s * 0.08, p[1] + h + s * 0.06) : ctx.moveTo(p[0] + s * 0.08, p[1] + h + s * 0.06);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,12,0,0.38)';
  ctx.fill();
  // sides
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    const p0 = pts[i], p1 = pts[(i + 1) % 4];
    const mx = (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2 - x, my = (p0[1] + p1[1]) / 2 - y;
    if (my <= 0.001) continue;
    const len = Math.hypot(mx, my) || 1;
    const nx = mx / len, ny = my / len;
    const lit = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.max(0, nx * -0.5 + ny * 0.87);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p0[0], p0[1]);
    ctx.lineTo(p1[0], p1[1]);
    ctx.lineTo(p1[0], p1[1] + h);
    ctx.lineTo(p0[0], p0[1] + h);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = rgb(120 + 110 * lit, 85 + 85 * lit, 40 + 60 * lit);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(110,60,15,0.7)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  // top face
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) i ? ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]) : ctx.moveTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
  ctx.closePath();
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - s * 0.6, y - s * 0.3, x + s * 0.6, y + s * 0.3);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#f6ead0');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#e8d2a2');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.075;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c98b3c';
  ctx.stroke();
  // toasted flecks
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(190,120,50,0.35)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x - s * 0.15, y - s * 0.04, s * 0.16, s * 0.07, rot, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x + s * 0.18, y + s * 0.08, s * 0.10, s * 0.05, rot + 1, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawShiitake(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x + s * 0.07, y + s * 0.1, s * 0.64, s * 0.5, 0, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,12,0,0.4)';
  ctx.fill();
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - s * 0.2, y - s * 0.22, s * 0.04, x, y, s * 0.68);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#8a5630');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, '#583019');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#2f170c');
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, s * 0.62, s * 0.48, rot * 0.2, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,100,60,0.45)';
  ctx.stroke();
  // scored cross
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(rot);
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  for (const a of [0, PI / 2]) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.rotate(a);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-s * 0.36, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.36, 0);
    ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.09;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(232,205,160,0.85)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.03;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,30,10,0.7)';
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.rotate(-rot);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(-s * 0.2, -s * 0.2, s * 0.22, s * 0.11, -0.6, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,225,190,0.16)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawBokChoy(x, y, s, dir, t) {
  const sway = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * s * 0.02;
  ctx.save();
  // stem
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.2, y + s * 0.02);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - s * 0.12 + dir * s * 0.05, y - s * 0.5, x + dir * s * 0.22 - s * 0.13 + sway, y - s * 0.95);

function drawNori(x, y, R, t) {
  const w = R * 0.42, h = R * 0.36;
  const lean = R * 0.07 + Math.sin(t * 0.4) * R * 0.004;
  const bl = [x - w * 0.5, y + h * 0.05], br = [x + w * 0.5, y - h * 0.08];
  const tl = [bl[0] - lean, bl[1] - h], tr = [br[0] - lean * 0.85, br[1] - h * 0.98];
  ctx.save();
  // shadow on the broth / wall
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bl[0] + R * 0.02, bl[1] + R * 0.02);
  ctx.lineTo(br[0] + R * 0.02, br[1] + R * 0.03);
  ctx.lineTo(br[0] + R * 0.1, br[1] + R * 0.06);
  ctx.lineTo(bl[0] + R * 0.1, bl[1] + R * 0.05);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(30,8,0,0.45)';
  ctx.fill();
  // sheet with slightly torn edges
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(bl[0], bl[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(br[0], br[1]);
  ctx.lineTo(tr[0] + R * 0.01, tr[1] + R * 0.02);
  ctx.lineTo(tr[0] - R * 0.03, tr[1] - R * 0.005);
  ctx.lineTo(tl[0] + R * 0.04, tl[1] + R * 0.012);
  ctx.lineTo(tl[0], tl[1] + R * 0.03);
  ctx.closePath();
  let g = ctx.createLinearGradient(tl[0], tl[1], br[0], br[1]);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#22352a');
  g.addColorStop(0.45, '#15251b');
  g.addColorStop(0.6, '#2a4030');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0f1a13');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
  ctx.stroke();
  // sheen
  ctx.clip();
  g = ctx.createLinearGradient(tl[0], tl[1], tl[0] + w * 0.6, tl[1] + h * 0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0.3, 'rgba(150,190,150,0)');
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(150,190,150,0.16)');
  g.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(150,190,150,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(tl[0] - R, tl[1] - R, R * 3, R * 3);
  // paper texture: faint horizontal fibers
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,210,170,0.06)';
  for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) {
    const k = i / 9;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lerp(tl[0], bl[0], k), lerp(tl[1], bl[1], k));
    ctx.lineTo(lerp(tr[0], br[0], k), lerp(tr[1], br[1], k));
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCarrot(x, y, s, rot) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(1, 0.85);
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
    const a = i / 60 * TAU;
    const r = s * (0.84 + 0.16 * Math.cos(5 * (a + rot)));
    i ? ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r + 1, Math.sin(a) * r + 2) : ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r + 1, Math.sin(a) * r + 2);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40,12,0,0.35)';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
    const a = i / 60 * TAU;
    const r = s * (0.84 + 0.16 * Math.cos(5 * (a + rot)));
    i ? ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r) : ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f0872a';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c45d16';
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.5, 0, TAU);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,140,0.6)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, s * 0.18, 0, TAU);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#f9b76e';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawChopsticks(px, py) {
  const { R, ry } = L;
  const cx = L.cx + px, cy = L.cy + py;
  const x0 = cx + R * 1.32, y0 = cy + ry * 1.7;   // handles, resting outside the bowl
  const x1 = cx + R * 0.10, y1 = cy - ry * 0.68;  // tips, resting in the noodles
  const dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;
  const stick = (off, wa, wb, fill, ox, oy) => {
    const ax = x0 + nx * off + ox, ay = y0 + ny * off + oy;
    const bx = x1 + nx * off + ox, by = y1 + ny * off + oy;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(ax + nx * wa, ay + ny * wa);
    ctx.lineTo(bx + nx * wb, by + ny * wb);
    ctx.lineTo(bx - nx * wb, by - ny * wb);
    ctx.lineTo(ax - nx * wa, ay - ny * wa);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = fill;
    ctx.fill();
  };
  ctx.save();
  // shadow on rim and broth
  stick(-R * 0.03, R * 0.02, R * 0.011, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)', R * 0.025, R * 0.04);
  stick(R * 0.03, R * 0.02, R * 0.011, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)', R * 0.025, R * 0.04);
  for (const off of [-R * 0.03, R * 0.03]) {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0 + nx * (off - R * 0.02), y0 + ny * (off - R * 0.02), x0 + nx * (off + R * 0.02), y0 + ny * (off + R * 0.02));
    g.addColorStop(0, '#6e421f');
    g.addColorStop(0.35, '#b47a44');
    g.addColorStop(0.55, '#c98e55');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#5c3418');
    stick(off, R * 0.019, R * 0.010, g, 0, 0);
    // end-grain darkening toward the tip that sits in the broth
    const g2 = ctx.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1);
    g2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g2.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(60,20,0,0.5)');
    stick(off, R * 0.019, R * 0.010, g2, 0, 0);
    // light line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0 + nx * (off - R * 0.006), y0 + ny * (off - R * 0.006));
    ctx.lineTo(x1 + nx * (off - R * 0.003), y1 + ny * (off - R * 0.003));
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,190,0.35)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawSteam(t, px, py, fl) {
  const { R, bx, by } = L;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  // resting haze above the bowl
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(bx + px + m.ex * R * 0.08, by - R * 0.85 + py);
  ctx.scale(1, 1.25);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05 * fl * (1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 0.4)) * (1 + m.hoverAmt * 0.4);
  ctx.fillStyle = hazeGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(-R * 1.3, -R * 1.3, R * 2.6, R * 2.6);
  ctx.restore();
  for (const p of steam) {
    const k = p.life / p.max;
    const a = Math.sin(k * PI) * p.a;
    if (a <= 0.002) continue;
    const s = p.s0 + p.grow * k;
    ctx.globalAlpha = a;
    ctx.translate(p.x + px, p.y + py);
    ctx.rotate(p.rot);
    ctx.drawImage(steamSprite, -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStaticSteam() {
  const { R, bx, by } = L;
  const g = mulberry32(5);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
  ctx.translate(bx, by - R * 0.85);
  ctx.scale(1, 1.25);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.06;
  ctx.fillStyle = hazeGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(-R * 1.3, -R * 1.3, R * 2.6, R * 2.6);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    const k = g();
    const s = R * (0.25 + k * 0.45);
    const x = bx + (g() - 0.5) * R * 1.1 + Math.sin(k * 9) * R * 0.15;
    const y = by - R * 0.15 - k * R * 1.5;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.045 + (1 - Math.abs(k - 0.4)) * 0.06;
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.rotate(g() * TAU);
    ctx.drawImage(steamSprite, -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawVignette() {
  ctx.fillStyle = vignetteGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function render(t) {
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  const fl = reduced ? 1 : flicker(t);
  const px = m.ex * L.R * 0.035, py = m.ey * L.R * 0.025;

  drawBackground(t, fl);
  ctx.drawImage(bowlCache.cv, L.cx - bowlCache.ox + px, L.cy - bowlCache.oy + py, bowlCache.w, bowlCache.h);
  drawInnerWall(px, py);
  drawBroth(t, px * 0.85, py * 0.85, fl);
  drawRim(px, py, 'far');
  drawToppings(t, px * 0.9, py * 0.9);
  drawRim(px, py, 'near');
  drawChopsticks(px, py);
  if (reduced) drawStaticSteam(); else drawSteam(t, px * 1.15, py * 1.15, fl);
  drawVignette();
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- loop
let raf = 0, last = 0;

function frame(now) {
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  const t = now / 1000;
  let dt = last ? (now - last) / 1000 : 1 / 60;
  last = now;
  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
  step(t, dt);
  render(t);
}

function start() {
  if (raf) return;
  last = 0;
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function stop() {
  if (raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  raf = 0;
}

function renderStatic() {
  m.ex = m.ey = 0;
  m.hoverAmt = 0;
  render(0);
}

function warmUp() {
  // pre-roll the steam so the scene never opens cold
  steam.length = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) step(i / 30, 1 / 30);
}

function applyMode() {
  if (reduced) {
    stop();
    onLeave();
    steam.length = 0;
    ripples.length = 0;
    renderStatic();
  } else {
    warmUp();
    start();
  }
}

genContent();
layout();
applyMode();

let resizeTimer = 0;
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  layout();
  if (reduced) renderStatic();
  else {
    // keep steam anchored roughly to the new bowl position
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(warmUp, 120);
  }
});

mq.addEventListener ? mq.addEventListener('change', e => { reduced = e.matches; applyMode(); })
                    : mq.addListener(e => { reduced = e.matches; applyMode(); });

document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (reduced) return;
  if (document.hidden) stop(); else start();
});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove, { passive: true });
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown, { passive: true });
canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave', onLeave);
canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', onLeave);
window.addEventListener('blur', onLeave);
})();
